title: Chart crosshair
description: Read an individual point accurately while retaining the shape of the series.
useCase: Read an individual point accurately while retaining the shape of the series.
reducedMotion: Live system preference disables decorative motion; all controls remain usable. Keyboard actions settle immediately.
limitations: Twelve fixed weeks of sample data; keyboard arrows, Home, and End inspect the same points as the pointer.
look: White rounded card on pale sage: a large dark-green figure above a thin green line chart with faint area fill, dashed gridlines and crosshair.
motion: Moving the pointer, dragging on touch, or pressing arrow, Home and End snaps a dashed crosshair and ringed marker to the nearest weekly point, updating the value instantly.
adapt: `inspect` converts pointer x into the nearest `index` (points sit 26 units apart in a 310-wide `viewBox`), which positions the crosshair and marker; keys call `setIndex`. Replace `values`, the 134 multiplier and the axis dates with your series.
